description: SISTERS, OR- Today, Deschutes County Commissioner and candidate for Oregon's 5th Congressional District, Patti Adair, condemned Congresswoman Janelle Bynum's vote against the National Fraud Enforcement Division Act of 2026. Commissioner Adair stated the following: “You would think that voting to create a national fraud division within the Department of Justice would be a very easy yes vote.
